info.title: ClawdDarkPrivateX402
info.description: Privacy-first x402 payments on Solana using Dark-DeFi shielded infrastructure. Extends the standard x402 scheme with a 'dark-shielded' variant: USDC transfers routed through Zcash Sapling-derived shielded notes, breaking the payment graph between caller and API operator. AI inference runs inside TEE (SGX/SEV) enclaves attested on-chain via SAS — prompts and completions never appear in plaintext on the Solana ledger.

post.description: Returns a 402-style payment challenge using the 'dark-shielded' x402 scheme. The payTo address is a one-time diversified Sapling address generated fresh per request — unlinkable to the operator's on-chain identity. The caller funds a shielded note; the operator's scanning key detects it without exposing the graph.

amount_hint.description: Suggested USDC amount in base units — server may override

payTo.description: Diversified Sapling address (one-time, unlinkable to operator)

ephemeral_key.description: ECDH ephemeral key for note encryption

commitment_tree_root.description: Current Merkle root for proof verification

post.summary: Verify a shielded payment without settling
post.description: Verifies a dark-shielded payment proof. Checks: note commitment exists in the Merkle tree, nullifier has not been spent, ZK ownership proof is valid, amount meets the requirement. Does not submit on-chain.

post.summary: Settle a shielded payment and grant access
post.description: Verifies the shielded proof, marks the nullifier as spent on the Dark Protocol Anchor program (program ID: 4753b1cCrPzwr7taWWD8yrcM8dc98fTR7wCFdv1TsAbg), and returns a signed access token scoped to the requested resource and nonce.

access_token.description: Short-lived signed token — present as X-Dark-Access header on the resource request

nullifier_tx.description: On-chain tx signature registering the spent nullifier

402.description: Proof invalid or nullifier already spent

post.summary: Privacy-preserving AI inference in a TEE enclave
post.description: Chat completion inside an SGX/SEV trusted execution environment attested via the Solana Attestation Service (SAS). Prompts are encrypted client-side before entering the enclave; completions are encrypted before leaving. Neither the operator nor the network sees plaintext. Requires a dark-shielded payment settled via /shielded/settle.

encrypted_messages.description: ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted message objects. Encrypt with the enclave's public key from /tee/pubkey.

encrypted_content.description: Base64 ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext of the completion, encrypted with caller's ephemeral key

attestation.description: Base64 SAS attestation quote proving the enclave produced this response

get.summary: Get TEE enclave encryption public key
get.description: Returns the current ChaCha20-Poly1305 / X25519 public key for the active TEE enclave, along with its SAS attestation. Use to encrypt messages before sending to /tee/inference.

post.summary: Generate a Sapling shielded wallet address
post.description: Derives a Zcash Sapling-compatible shielded address from a ZIP-32 HD seed for use as a private payer identity. Call client-side via @openclawdsol/dark-protocol-sdk; this endpoint is for demo/test flows only.

viewing_key.description: Incoming viewing key for scanning notes

nullifier.description: 32-byte nullifier (Base64) — derived from the spent note

commitment.description: 32-byte note commitment (Base64) — proves the note exists in the Merkle tree

merkle_path.description: Merkle authentication path from leaf to root

amount.description: USDC base units — must meet the challenge maxAmountRequired

payer_ephemeral_pk.description: Payer's X25519 ephemeral public key for response encryption

darkAccess.name: X-Dark-Access
darkAccess.description: Short-lived access token returned by POST /shielded/settle after successful ZK proof verification.
